parts:
Hi lavaan community,

I am running a hybrid choice model in R to calculate the direct and indirect effects.
I have provided conceptual model, R code, and model output in the attached word doc. My indicators to extract latent variables are on likert scale. So, I thought of using WLS estimator. In my limited experience in lavaan, I have the following queries:

1. I mentioned the R code from EFA to CFA to SEM model specification. Is the whole code right?

2.  Few papers with ordinal scales like mine have shown only beta value (estimate and p value whereas few others have reported estimates, z values, and thresholds in their papers. There are 7 sections namely latent variables, regressions, intercepts, variances, thresholds, scales, and R square in model output. If this output is correct, may I know how to report the main effects and interaction(indirect effects) for research paper?

3. Besides, I am wondering why some columns in intercepts output are left blank and what does it mean?

Any sort of clarifications would be of great help. Thank you.
